title: 9 Signs a Godly Man's Humility Is Real, Not Performed
caption:
Performed humility has an audience. Real humility doesn't check who's watching.

Anyone can look humble in the caption. The test is what he does with credit, correction, and the win nobody's around to see.

Humble yourselves before the Lord, and he will exalt you (James 4:10). He's not the main character, and he's stopped needing to be.

Which one of these is the hardest for you?

#godlyman #humility #christianman #character #faith
